dataList.content:
A perfected Identity...?
完美状态下的人格？
dataList.place:
Wuthering Heights Laboratory
呼啸山庄 实验室

dataList.content:
... Who is he talking about?
……他在说谁呢？

He's... coming back.
他终于……又回来了。

Heathcliff... now fully primed...
完成所有准备的……那个希斯克利夫……

dataList.title:
A Distant World
另一个世界
dataList.content:
Yes. I have returned.
是啊，我又回来了。

dataList.title:
A Distant World
另一个世界
dataList.content:
I, whose existence itself has become a sin... have returned to put an end to us all.
存在本身即是罪孽的我，为了终结所有的我们而归来了。

... You accursed beast...! Infernal demon... you've finally come to take our manor, 'ave you...?
那个混账……那个从地狱归来的混账……终于要将我们的宅邸……

Mistress, I shall not let that interloper... who dared to stain the honour of our manor...
夫人，我一定要将……那个玷污我们宅邸的混账……

Gah, kaugh...!
咳……咳咳……

dataList.title:
A Distant World
另一个世界
dataList.content:
HAHAHAHAHA!
哈哈哈哈哈！

dataList.title:
A Distant World
另一个世界
dataList.content:
Every Wuthering Heights, at the end of all things in every world, eventually became mine!
无论哪个世界的呼啸山庄，在最后的最后，都会成为我的东西。

dataList.title:
A Distant World
另一个世界
dataList.content:
Every single death Hindley and Linton suffered was pathetic and writhing. And that shall be an immutable truth for all eternity to come.
无论哪个亨德利和林顿都是凄惨地挣扎着死去，今后也会如此。

dataList.title:
A Distant World
另一个世界
dataList.content:
Thus Josephine, it is only right that you are mine as well.
因此，约瑟芬，你也是我的所有物。

dataList.title:
A Distant World
另一个世界
dataList.content:
You are bound to heed my commands.
要侍奉于我。

M-Mistress, this vagabond... he's...!
夫……夫人，这家伙……这家伙把我们……

dataList.title:
A Distant World
另一个世界
dataList.content:
I tire of your ramblings of your 'Mistress'. She is nothing but a rotting corpse, her flesh decayed and bones desiccated.
我已经受够了你常挂在嘴上的那已经腐烂了很久的夫人。

Josephine fell limp and motionless in Heathcliff's grasp.
在希斯克利夫的手中，约瑟芬全身瘫软，一动不动。

dataList.title:
A Distant World
另一个世界
dataList.content:
Ah! Josephine, Hindley, Linton! All of their pitiful souls tangled and fettered to this accursed destiny in every world! I have seen you far too many times in far too many worlds.
来吧！约瑟芬，亨德利，还有林顿！这可恨的命运无论在哪个世界，都将你们紧紧缠绕。

dataList.title:
A Distant World
另一个世界
dataList.content:
I shall take you away from here, you pitiful souls who remain bound to Wuthering Heights even in death.
你们这些死了也逃不出呼啸山庄的可怜鬼，就让我来带你们走吧。

The husks of dead Peccatula, Lintons, Hindleys, Josephines... all began to materialize and rise. They begin to form a procession.
倒在地上的罪种之壳、林顿、亨德利和约瑟芬缓缓站了起来，排成了队列。

The countless bodies, husks, the wailing things in their wake...
他们经过之处那无数的尸体、壳以及在地板上哭嚎的所有东西……

... all join the march.
都成了那游行的一部分，一起行动起来。

dataList.title:
A Distant World
另一个世界
dataList.content:
Thus approaches the final chapter of this tale.
让我们迈向终章吧。

The other Heathcliff stands on the vanguard of the march, and lifts Catherine's Coffin onto his back.
站在那游行最前面的希斯克利夫背着凯瑟琳的棺材。

You... you can't do that to Catherine—!
你……不能那么对凯瑟琳……！

dataList.title:
A Distant World
另一个世界
dataList.content:
Fine. I suppose we could play a game. It has been a while, hasn't it?
是啊，久违地玩玩也不坏。

dataList.title:
A Distant World
另一个世界
dataList.content:
Remember? We used to play games with Catherine on the rooftop of this manor. Why not reminisce upon that sweet memory, hm?
让我们再度仔细品味一下与凯瑟琳一起在屋顶上玩乐的记忆吧，嗯？

dataList.title:
A Distant World
另一个世界
dataList.content:
If you wish to join us, pursue me. Pursue me and rise through the stairwell until your strength fails, Heathcliff.
如果你想要加入进来的话，就全力追赶攀登吧。希斯克利夫。

Heathcliff takes a step forward to seize him, but...
希斯克利夫为了抓住他冲上前去，但是……

... the endless march stands in his way.
那无尽的游行挡在了他的面前。

dataList.title:
A Distant World
另一个世界
dataList.content:
Oh, but it will not be that easy. Nor should it be.
但是你不会那么容易地跨越这一切的。

dataList.title:
A Distant World
另一个世界
dataList.content:
Your heart toward Catherine shan't be realized so painlessly.
你思念凯瑟琳的心愿，不可能就这么轻易实现。

dataList.title:
A Distant World
另一个世界
dataList.content:
You must suffer more. Let desperation consume you. Become frenzied in your pursuit.
还得更痛苦、更凄惨、更残酷才行。

<The rooftop... >
<屋顶上有……>

Indeed, the roof houses the Golden Bough. When the two Golden Boughs come into physical contact with one another, they...
是的，那里有金枝。如果两根金枝互相接触的话……

... I can think of a thousand different outcomes.
我已经能想到可能会发生的千百种情景了。

I don't know what he's planning to do with Catherine, but...
虽然我不清楚他带走凯瑟琳要做什么……

We have to stop him... we have to...!
但我们一定要……阻止他……

Our retreat's been cut off. No way forward, no way back.
四面楚歌了啊。

<Are they... Hindley, Linton, and Josephine from other worlds?>
<那些是……别的世界的亨德利、林顿和约瑟芬吗？>

They appear to be imperfect Identities, summoned from worlds chosen at random. It is the fate that awaits all those who become thralls to that Heathcliff.
推测那些是从随机世界中召唤而来的残缺人格。而且还是他们沦落为那位希斯克利夫影响下的附庸的末路。

A phenomenon in which a Mirror World entity wreaks havoc across the dimensions in pursuit of every Heathcliff... In other words, the 'Wild Hunt'.
那是他想要杀死每一个镜像世界里存在的希斯克利夫而扰乱次元产生的现象之一……狂猎。应该如此称呼吧。

Like the Nocturnal March of a Hundred Demons.
是百鬼夜行呢。

<So... there's no end to them?>
<也就是说……从现在起……他们会一直没完没了吗？>

He is the conduit that has brought them all to this world. He leads this army at its vanguard, as its Erlkönig... or the Erlking.
……他那召唤他们，率领那只军队的样子简直如同魔王一般。

This army will never stop until the Erlking's orders are withdrawn.
直到那位魔王倒下之前，他们都绝不会停下吧。

A brutal tempest... descends...
狂风……在猛烈呼啸……
